thread:
Maya (CS): Quick heads up — prepping prefill/backfill plan for Acme go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need alignment on prefill size, backfill window, streaming fallback, and a lightweight way to capture renewal risk signals during demo.

Tom (Solutions): Proposed 3-tier approach: 1) Warm prefix prefill (50 reqs per tenant, ~200 tokens each) 2) Time-boxed backfill (2h off-peak batch with TTL) 3) Live stream fallback with token cap and degrade to smaller model. Keeps latency predictable.

Oliver (SRE): Agree on the tiers. Watch GPU queue depth and tail latency. Recommend autoscale +20% burst for backfill window. Backfill is heavy — require per-tenant rate-limit keys and soft quota.

Paula (Acct Exec): Customer is fine with a short overnight backfill but wants clear billing/usage visibility and an opt-out. Can we add an opt-out checkbox in the enablement flow?

Maya (CS): Yes — include opt-out. Also need a simple prefill API snippet for SEs and a small telemetry checklist CS can monitor during go-live.

Tom (Solutions): Prefill API snippet (idempotent; use tenant API key):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TENANT_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme-123","strategy":"prefix","requests":[{"prompt":"<warmup>","tokens":200}],"concurrency":5}'
```

Tom (Solutions): For backfill, use `window_start` and `duration` params and set `burst:false` to avoid overrunning pooled capacity. Include a dry-run flag for staging.

Oliver (SRE): Telemetry to watch: `gpu_util`, `queue_depth`, `tail_p95_latency`, `prefill_success_rate`, `token_billed_rate`. Create alerts: queue_depth > 80% OR p95 > 1s sustained > 5m => page SRE.

Maya (CS): Add renewal-signal capture: show a 1–3 question micro-survey after the tenant's first 100 interactions. If score < 3, emit event `renewal_concern` to CRM and flag account owner.

Paula (Acct Exec): I'll surface the one-question survey in the demo flow. Text idea: "How confident are you that this will meet your needs? (1-5)" plus one short free-text field.

Tom (Solutions): Streaming fallback config sample: `stream_threshold_tokens=512`, `fallback_model=small-v2`, `enable_kv_cache_prefetch=true`. That gives graceful degradation while preserving conversational continuity.

Oliver (SRE): We'll run a staging dry-run: backfill on staging tenant at 02:00 PT for 30m to validate autoscale and rate limits. Deploy-bot will emit the job id when started.

deploy-bot: prefill_job_started: job_id=pf_2026032101 tenant=acme-123 window=2026-03-21T02:00:00Z duration=30m

Maya (CS): Action items — (1) Tom: push prefill examples + one-pager to repo, (2) Oliver: configure autoscale + schedule staging dry-run, (3) Paula: prepare opt-out checkbox and survey text. I'll run the enablement checklist at 08:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Tom (Solutions): Got it — I'll open a PR and drop the link here when ready.

Oliver (SRE): Dry-run scheduled. Will ping here if we need capacity tweaks.

Paula (Acct Exec): On it — will also include the billing note and opt-out verbiage for the customer-facing enablement doc.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — this feels ready. Will post the final one-pager after Tom's PR and Oliver's dry-run result.
